title: ORNL Pathways to Computing Internship Program (PCIP) - Summer 2027
summary: The Pathways to Computing Internship Program at Oak Ridge National Laboratory is a 10-week summer program offering undergraduate students hands-on experience in computer science, computational science, and mathematics. Participants work alongside research staff and gain access to ORNL's world-class computing facilities. The program provides a weekly stipend, housing assistance, and travel reimbursement for non-local students.
citizenship: Currently enrolled full-time undergraduate students returning for Fall 2027.

title: The Green Teams Program 2027
org: Montclair State University, PSEG Institute for Sustainability Studies
summary: Full-time, 11-week summer internship where teams of five students from different majors work on sustainability projects for companies, nonprofits, towns and community groups. Interns train on campus, visit host sites and finish with a report and group presentation.
citizenship: Upper-level undergraduates from any major with an interest in sustainability

title: CALIBIR Summer Research Internship
org: Wake Forest University School of Medicine
summary: The CALIBIR Summer Research Internship is an NIH-funded 10-week program offering undergraduate and master's students hands-on research experience in translational artificial intelligence and biomedical informatics. Interns participate in professional development, seminars, and collaborative research projects while receiving hourly pay and on-campus housing.
citizenship: Enrolled US undergrad/master's students, 18+, min 3.0 GPA, completed at least two semesters, not graduating before May 2027.
